description: $0.01 per call. Use to screen or poll new pons memecoin launches on Robinhood Chain (chain 4663; default last hour, newest first) as compact structure cards: raised (ETH) and progress to the 4.2 ETH graduation, price multiple, fee and creator tax in bps, snipe-tax activity, holder concentration, same-block cluster share (matching timing, not proof of coordination), a ring block, each with verdict and basis (avoid | caution | no_flags_observed by the fixed public rule, /v1/labels rhc_verdict). ring_only returns only ring-shaped curves with the rule and its base rates; since (a previous next_cursor) returns only newer launches, oldest first. An unavailable Robinhood Chain reader is refused before payment. One token: rhc_curve_card. Not Solana.
